item.title: A Note for the Chess Club
item.prompt_text: Chess club is today. It starts at 4 p.m. at the blue table in the hall. Lena has the chess pieces, so your classmate Ben needs to bring only a board. Write a note to Ben.
item.target_grammar: Present simple for time; bring and go for instructions.
item.target_structure: Greeting → time and place → what to bring → goodbye.

checklist.point: Explain what Ben needs to bring.
